name: check_layers

test_list.description: An edge to a strictly lower layer in another group passes.
An edge between different groups on the same layer yields NotDownward.
A parent facade may depend on its child on the same layer.
A child depending on its own parent facade yields ChildToParent.
A sibling edge pointing to a higher layer yields NotDownward.
An internal dependency present in cargo metadata but absent from the table (or vice versa) yields EdgeMismatch.

inputs.name: table
inputs.description: Parsed crate table (layers, parents, declared edges).

inputs.name: actual
inputs.description: Internal edges per package from cargo metadata.

output_description: All layer and edge violations; empty when the graph obeys the layer rule.
